hypotheses.justification: hX is used only via heatE_times_U (heatE_before and U_after_switch). The statement is still true for X ≤ 0, with K = switchRadius F XR > 0 (switchRadius_pos). Definitions: heatE = OutgoingDilation.E * multiplier, multiplier = 1 + switch K X * (...), switch K X = sigma(Real.log (X/K)/(3/10)), and U F XR (X,eta) = F.U (X/XR, eta) = F.logU (Real.log (X/XR), eta). If X = 0, Real.log 0 = 0, so switch = sigma 0 = 0 (OutgoingSchedule.sigma_zero), the multiplier is 1, and heatE = OutgoingDilation.E. If X < 0 and -X ≤ K, Real.log_neg_eq_log gives Real.log (X/K) = Real.log ((-X)/K) ≤ 0, so switch = 0 and the multiplier is 1. If X < 0 and -X > K, then Real.log (X/XR) = Real.log ((-X)/XR) by Real.log_neg_eq_log and neg_div, so U F XR (X,eta) = U F XR (-X,eta) = 0 by U_after_switch at -X; both sides are then _ * 0 = 0. The patch part (correction_times_U_zero) takes no hypothesis on X. So the proof only needs heatE_times_U reproved by a case split on 0 < X, where the positive case is the existing proof. hXR is still needed (U_on_patch).
